description: This file defines the 'terrain_builder' class used for constructing and managing terrain graphics in the Wesnoth game engine. It includes methods for parsing configuration, applying terrain rules, managing terrain constraints, and handling terrain-related image variants and caching.

classes.name: terrain_builder
classes.description: Main class for constructing and managing terrain graphics, applying rules, and caching terrain images based on configuration and map data.

classes.name: terrain_builder::rule_image_variant
classes.description: Represents a variant of an image with associated time-of-day and animated locator.

classes.name: terrain_builder::rule_image
classes.description: Represents a terrain image with position, layer, variants, and global/local scope.

classes.name: terrain_builder::terrain_constraint
classes.description: Represents constraints for matching terrain tiles, including location, terrain types, flags, and associated images.

classes.name: terrain_builder::tile
classes.description: Represents a map tile with flags, images, and methods for cache management and image addition.

classes.name: terrain_builder::tilemap
classes.description: Manages a grid of tiles for the terrain, providing access and reset functionality.

classes.name: terrain_builder::building_rule
classes.description: Represents a set of constraints, location, probability, and precedence for terrain rules.

methods.name: terrain_builder::terrain_builder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes terrain builder with configuration and map data.

methods.name: terrain_builder::get_terrain_at
methods.description: Returns a list of animated images for a specific terrain location, time-of-day, and terrain type.

methods.name: terrain_builder::update_animation
methods.description: Updates animation state for a terrain tile, returns true if redraw is needed.

methods.name: terrain_builder::rebuild_terrain
methods.description: Performs a quick rebuild of terrain at a specific location, resetting cache.

methods.name: terrain_builder::rebuild_all
methods.description: Rebuilds terrain graphics for the entire map.

methods.name: terrain_builder::rule_valid
methods.description: Checks if a terrain rule is valid (all images present).

methods.name: terrain_builder::start_animation
methods.description: Starts animation for a terrain rule.

methods.name: terrain_builder::rotate
methods.description: Rotates a terrain constraint by a specified angle.

methods.name: terrain_builder::replace_token
methods.description: Replaces tokens in strings, rule variants, images, and rules with specified values.

methods.name: terrain_builder::rotate_rule
methods.description: Rotates a terrain rule template to a specified angle, generating multiple rules.

methods.name: terrain_builder::add_images_from_config
methods.description: Parses image configurations and adds rule images to a list.

methods.name: terrain_builder::add_constraints
methods.description: Creates and adds terrain constraints based on location, type, and configuration.

methods.name: terrain_builder::parse_mapstring
methods.description: Parses a map string to add constraints to a terrain rule.

methods.name: terrain_builder::add_rule
methods.description: Adds a terrain rule to the ruleset after validation.

methods.name: terrain_builder::add_rotated_rules
methods.description: Generates and adds rotated versions of a template rule to the ruleset.

methods.name: terrain_builder::parse_config
methods.description: Parses terrain graphics rules from configuration and populates rules.

methods.name: terrain_builder::terrain_matches
methods.description: Checks if a terrain letter matches a list of terrain types.

methods.name: terrain_builder::rule_matches
methods.description: Checks if a rule matches a specific map location.

methods.name: terrain_builder::apply_rule
methods.description: Applies a terrain rule to a specific map location, setting images and flags.

methods.name: terrain_builder::get_constraint_adjacents
methods.description: Returns the number of adjacent constraints for a given constraint.

methods.name: terrain_builder::get_constraint_size
methods.description: Calculates the number of map tiles a constraint may match.

methods.name: terrain_builder::build_terrains
methods.description: Builds terrain data and fills tile map based on rules and map.
